title: Salidroside protects pulmonary artery endothelial cells against hypoxia-induced apoptosis via the AhR/NF-kappaB and Nrf2/HO-1 pathways.
authors: Lei, Wei; Chen, Mei-Hong; Huang, Zu-Feng; Chen, Xiao-Ying; Wang, Jin-Xia; Zheng, Jing; Zhu, Yi-Zhun; Lan, Xiao-Zhong; He, Yuan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红景天苷通过AhR/NF-kB和Nrf2/HO-1通路保护肺动脉内皮细胞抗缺氧凋亡，属于细胞信号通路与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The apoptosis of pulmonary artery endothelial cells (PAECs) is an important factor contributing to the development of pulmonary hypertension (PH), a serious cardio-pulmonary vascular disorder. Salidroside (SAL) is a bioactive compound derived from an herb Rhodiola, but the potential protective effects of SAL on PAECs and the underlying mechanisms remain elusive. PURPOSE: The objective of this study was to determine the role of SAL in the hypoxia-induced apoptosis of PAECs and to dissect the underlying mechanisms. STUDY DESIGN: Male Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats were subjected to hypoxia (10% O(2)) for 4 weeks to establish a model of PH. Rats were intraperitoneally injected daily with SAL (2, 8, and 32 mg/kg/d) or vehicle. To define the molecular mechanisms of SAL in PAECs, an in vitro model of hypoxic cell injury was also generated by exposed PAECs to 1% O(2) for 48 h. METHODS: Various techniques including hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining, immunofluorescence, flow cytometry, CCK-8, Western blot, qPCR, molecular docking, and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) were used to determine the role of SAL in rats and in PAECs in vitro. RESULTS: Hypoxia stimulation increases AhR nuclear translocation and activates the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, as evidenced by upregulated expression of CYP1A1, CYP1B1, IL-1beta, and IL-6, resulting in oxidative stress and inflammatory response and ultimately apoptosis of PAECs. SAL inhibited the activation of AhR and NF-kappaB, while promoted the nuclear translocation of Nrf2 and increased the expression of its downstream antioxidant proteins HO-1 and NQO1 in PAECs, ameliorating the hypoxia-induced oxidative stress in PAECs. Furthermore, SAL lowered right ventricular systolic pressure, and decreased pulmonary vascular remodeling and right ventricular hypertrophy in hypoxia-exposed rats. CONCLUSIONS: SAL may attenuate the apoptosis of PAECs by suppressing NF-kappaB and activating Nrf2/HO-1 pathways, thereby delaying the progressive pathology of PH.
abstract_zh: 背景：肺动脉内皮细胞（PAECs）的凋亡是肺动脉高压（PH）发生发展的重要因素，PH是一种严重的心肺血管疾病。红景天苷（SAL）是从红景天属植物中提取的一种生物活性化合物，但SAL对PAECs的潜在保护作用及其潜在机制仍不明确。目的：本研究旨在确定SAL在缺氧诱导的PAECs凋亡中的作用，并解析其潜在机制。研究设计：雄性Sprague-Dawley（SD）大鼠暴露于缺氧（10% O(2)）4周以建立PH模型。大鼠每日腹腔注射SAL（2、8和32 mg/kg/d）或载体。为明确SAL在PAECs中的分子机制，还通过将PAECs暴露于1% O(2) 48小时构建了体外缺氧细胞损伤模型。方法：采用多种技术，包括苏木精-伊红（HE）染色、免疫荧光、流式细胞术、CCK-8、Western blot、qPCR、分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR），以确定SAL在大鼠和体外PAECs中的作用。结果：缺氧刺激增加AhR核转位并激活NF-kappaB信号通路，表现为CYP1A1、CYP1B1、IL-1beta和IL-6表达上调，导致氧化应激和炎症反应，最终引起PAECs凋亡。SAL抑制了AhR和NF-kappaB的激活，同时促进Nrf2的核转位并增加其下游抗氧化蛋白HO-1和NQO1在PAECs中的表达，改善了缺氧诱导的PAECs氧化应激。此外，SAL降低了缺氧暴露大鼠的右心室收缩压，并减轻了肺血管重塑和右心室肥厚。结论：SAL可能通过抑制NF-kappaB和激活Nrf2/HO-1通路来减轻PAECs的凋亡，从而延缓PH的进行性病理过程。
